message: As I sift through old boxes in the attic, I’m reminded of simpler times when we’d gather around the table playing card games or sharing stories during power outages. It’s a lovely way to bond, and it got me thinking about how we can embrace low-tech fun while also being prepared. I found a helpful resource that reminds us of the essentials for a survival kit — it’s a good way to blend practicality with a little nostalgia. 😊 Have you rediscovered any low-tech joys lately?
